title: Retire or reword upstream-backlog-watch.yml (stale Backlog.md notices after the Quest cutover); decide whether lore's own docs gate runs lore check --strict
description: After 0.15.1, not in it: both are CI workflow changes (DEC-182 (1) floor items). Issue opum-ai/lore-cli#1 was a notice from this workflow about LORE-253, which no longer exists as a record; it was closed. Reword or retire the workflow so it stops filing notices. Separately, the #744 review noted that lore check (docs gate) now passes with a stale lore:tasks block unless it runs --strict; decide whether the repo's own gate should adopt --strict.
